topic: Your brain's best guess 8: Vulnerability looks different from the outside
caption:
Your thumb hovers over send on the message that starts “I got that wrong.”

It can feel as if admitting a mistake will make you look weak. In studies, people judged their own moments of vulnerability more harshly than the same moments in others. Vulnerability looks different from the outside, and the gap was smaller in people who tended to treat themselves with more kindness.

Before you decide, ask how you would see it if a friend did the same thing.

Your brain's best guess is our series on everyday predictions that research suggests are often too pessimistic. Studies were with university students in Germany using imagined scenarios, so results may differ for you.

Research: Bruk, A., Scholl, S. G., & Bless, H. (2022). You and I both: Self-compassion reduces self-other differences in evaluation of showing vulnerability. Personality and Social Psychology Bulletin, 48(7), 1054-1067. https://doi.org/10.1177/01461672211031080
